title: Security + hygiene batch: embed origin allowlist, safeHref, cookie flags, CORS example, gmail scrub, docs 404s, DDG fix
description: Review 2026-08-01 P2 batch. Security: /embed?agent-url= is attacker-controlled (allowlist against configured origin); window.open on citation urls with no scheme check (central safeHref, http/https only); auth cookie without httpOnly/secure/sameSite; CORS_ORIGINS=[*] example with credentials; note guest-endpoint rate-limit need. Hygiene: scrub personal gmail from tracked .beads/issues.jsonl (4 hits); docs/README.md links only nonexistent system-overview.md; SECURITY.md your-org link; .DS_Store tracked; internal CR bead ids in public docs/code comments -> plain language; frontend-integration-notes.md internal handoff doc -> neutral or delete; PLACEHOLDER markers on companyName/tagline/description + siteUrl example.com dev warning. i18n credibility: de Impressum cites repealed TMG -> §5 DDG; de 'ein maschinelles Zugangsdaten' grammar; es anglicisms + dialect mixing per review.

title: Chat correctness + a11y cluster: fullscreen state hoist, live latency tiers, guest nudge wiring, stream races, dialog semantics
description: Review 2026-08-01 P1s 6-12 (one lane, same files; run AFTER the grounded/demo lane lands). Fullscreen toggle mounts a second ChatPanel losing the whole conversation: hoist useA2AStream into ChatFab. stream-status-stack gates on isWaitingForResponse && !isThinking which never holds: latency tiers are dead code. layout.tsx never passes isGuest: conversion nudges can never fire; derive server-side. Stream ending without a terminal event finalizes as success: track sawTerminalEvent, honest error + keep partial. Double-send race: old turn's catch/finally resets the new turn: guard abortRef.current !== controller. A11y: closed drawer is aria-hidden yet focusable + composer autofocus steals focus on page load (inert/conditional render); no Escape/focus-trap on drawer/fullscreen/sheet: use Radix Dialog; portal the source sheet out of the transformed drawer.

title: Fork first-hour sweep: real ports, truthful env examples, working seed, one agent-URL shape
description: Review 2026-08-01 P1s 1-5. (1) start.sh files + package.json start on 3000/8000 while all docs teach 3100/8100: thread PORT/BACKEND_PORT defaults (3100/8100) through frontend+backend start paths, playwright.config, run-e2e-debug.sh. (2) backend/.env.example carries wrong ports (5432/1025/:3000) that OVERRIDE correct config.py defaults: regenerate truthfully. (3) frontend/.env.example lacks every documented var (CR_AGENT_URL/ORG_KEY/CHAT_FAB_ENABLED/BACKEND_ENABLED) while the root .env.example defines them where Next never reads: put them in frontend/.env.example. (4) seed_test_data.py imports nonexistent App model (ancestor debris): strip App logic, keep personas, make seed green. (5) NEXT_PUBLIC_CR_AGENT_URL has 3 incompatible documented shapes across .env.example/EXTENDING.md/integrating-with-contextrocket.md while code appends /api/agent/a2a itself: canonicalize ONE base-URL shape everywhere.
close_reason: fork first hour works: ports real, env truthful, seed green+idempotent, one agent-URL shape

title: Chat UX polish pack: icebreakers, suggestion pills, source sheet, policy-class card, conversion moments (docs/chat-experience.md)
description: Implement the chat experience contract in docs/chat-experience.md: (1) icebreaker chips + welcome from surface/site config, localized; (2) follow-up suggestion pills from stream metadata (never prose-parsed); (3) citation pills deduped by document + provenance source sheet; (4) policy-class card slot below the answer (typed classes -> severity-styled card + content key + optional CTA); (5) guest->registered conversion-moment nudges (turn threshold + value actions, one per session, dismissible, benefit-stated); (6) bubble typography rules (no headings in bubbles, More-detail expander, staggered pill/card entrance). Tri-locale, parity green, tests per component, no literal copy assertions. Acceptance: demo flow on /embed and the FAB shows icebreakers -> answer with lead-first typography -> pills -> deduped citations -> nudge at turn 3.
close_reason: polish pack landed; platform activation contract documented (suggestions[], policy_class{}, source_ref provenance fields)

title: content/faq seam: one curated FAQ file powers the FAQ page, FAQPage JSON-LD, and the agent corpus
description: A fork owner maintains content/faq.md (## Question headings + answers, per-locale variants alongside the i18n pattern). The starter renders: (1) /faq page with anchor slugs per question; (2) FAQPage JSON-LD via the existing structured-data module (answer-engine gold); (3) llms.txt + sitemap entries. The same file is the recommended seed corpus for the org's ContextRocket agent (ingestion happens platform-side; docs/integrating-with-contextrocket.md gains a section when the platform path ships). Ship a worked example file with placeholder Q&A. Acceptance: /faq builds statically with anchors; JSON-LD validates; parity green; README replace-me checklist gains the FAQ item; no hardcoded English.
close_reason: FAQ seam landed: file -> page + JSON-LD + documented agent-seed path

title: Auto-generate privacy policy + impressum content from site.config (no manual page editing)
description: Automate legal pages fully from site.config so forks never hand-edit them. Impressum already renders from siteConfig.legal. Privacy: replace the placeholder page with a GDPR-shaped policy GENERATED from config + actual app behavior: controller = legal.entity/address, contact = legal.privacyContact; processing sections conditional on what is enabled (auth cookies always; GA4/PostHog sections only when the env keys are set, mirroring lib/analytics.ts consent gating); consent/withdrawal section references the cookie banner. Visible 'generated from site.config, review with counsel before launch' note. README checklist items become 'fill site.config.legal' + 'review generated pages'. Blocked by the i18n locale lane: policy copy goes through i18n messages in all locales.

title: register.test.tsx asserts literal English copy (breaks i18n test doctrine)
description: register.test.tsx lines ~136-146 assert literal strings ('Invalid email address', 'Password should contain at least one uppercase letter.'). Tests must assert keys/behavior, not translated values; this coupled the suite to the active locale and caused a flaky interaction (mitigated by afterEach setLocale('en') in locale-provider.test). Fix: assert via message keys or testids.

title: Zero-config demo mode for the chat FAB (public demo endpoint)
description: When ContextRocket's public demo mode ships, default the FAB's first-run experience to it: clone, start, and chat works immediately against a rate-limited showcase org, no credential required. Setting your own org credential remains the upgrade path. Update README and docs/integrating-with-contextrocket.md when it lands.
close_reason: demo mode shipped consuming the real anon public-slug contract; grounded chip consumes real faithfulness metadata; activation = CR prod deploy + a published slug

title: Fix flaky use-a2a-stream test: setState after teardown race
description: hooks/use-a2a-stream.ts:307 setStreamingText fires after test teardown; the streaming test does not await/abort the stream in cleanup. Intermittent ELIFECYCLE suite failure observed 2026-08-01 (passes on rerun). Fix: wrap stream advancement in act() or abort the stream in afterEach. A public template must have zero-flake tests.
close_reason: unmount abort + mountedRef guard; suite green 3x
